question: Ticket 496dcbeba174 touches outline section 9.4.8, where Q#98 stands open: "The verdict's instrument run, and the proofs that exercise it, need bubblewrap, which Windows does not have, so `cairn test --exec` refuses there ("the instance seal is not confirmed ... bubblewrap (bwrap) is not installed") and three teeth stay red on Windows: test_the_instrument_is_run (two teeth) and the standing-verdict-proofs-stay-green check. answer: Q#98 does not bear on ticket 496dcbeba174, measured 2026-11-13 from its intention (CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/host-unprivileged-userns-for-the-tester-seal.json): it reads 'Every Linux box that runs cairn's tester allows unprivileged user namespaces under AppArmor', an Ubuntu sysctl recipe; Windows has no AppArmor key and no bwrap, so whether the Windows bwrap teeth skip or stay red cannot change it.
